title_suffix: finer certified endpoints (1e-60) and deeper outer witness on PR1424 (26 bootstrap steps, eta=beta=1e-76, kappa grid 1e-70); construction unchanged
summary: PR1424's construction is unchanged. The certified complex endpoints (native and conservative) are refined from the inherited 1e-24 bracket to 1e-60, each checked as accepted at the endpoint and rejected at endpoint+1e-60 by both rational moment engines (the retained Mercator engine and a finer-constant copy of the base-two engine), and the outer witness settings are deepened (bootstrap steps 26, eta = beta = 1e-76, backoff 1e-79, final kappa grid 1e-70). kappa moves from 0.001676855229071321886206381217337893 to 0.0016768552290713218862064567722745926195124487395104752628031703388673.
credits: PR1424, PR1319 and PR1297 (rohanarun: outer witness refinement, 74-replica exact fill, four cold kernels 531/543/555/567); PR1377 finer kappa grid and PR1274 helper-donor kernel (jeremykothe2); PR1286, PR1193 (jeremydiviney), PR1148 (Thomas DiFiore), PR1195/1196 and the retained lineage named in those packages.
